LESSON: MAIN PHYSICAL FEATURES IN EASTERN AFRICA

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Natural and the Built Environments
Topic 1.2: Main physical features in Eastern Africa
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Main physical features in Eastern Africa, part of Natural and the Built Environments in Grade 6 SOCIAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: How can we conserve physical features found in our locality? 2. Why are physical features important?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. discuss, in groups, and identify the main physical features in Eastern Africa (mountains - volcanic and bloc) - rift valleys, lakes, plains)

2. use digital devices to describe the formation of the main physical features in Eastern Africa,

3. draw a map of Eastern Africa, locate the main physical features, and display in class,

4. discuss ways of conserving the physical features within the locality to promote environmental education,

5. explore and identify the physical features within the locality. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. discuss, in groups, and identify the main physical features in Eastern Africa (mountains - volcanic and bloc) - rift valleys, lakes, plains)
2. use digital devices to describe the formation of the main physical features in Eastern Africa,
3. draw a map of Eastern Africa, locate the main physical features, and display in class,
4. discuss ways of conserving the physical features within the locality to promote environmental education,
5. explore and identify the physical features within the locality. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Main physical features in Eastern Africa together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Digital Literacy: Learners use digital devices to describe the formation of the main physical features in Eastern Africa.

Values:
● Unity: Learners display team spirit as they discuss, in groups, and identify the main physical features in Eastern Africa.

● Integrity: Learners display discipline as they use digital devices to describe the formation of the main physical features in

Eastern Africa.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Environmental Education: Learners discuss ways of conserving the physical features within the locality to promote

environmental education.

● Cooperation and Unity: Task oriented grouping as learners discuss, in groups, and identify the main physical features in

Eastern Africa

Link to other Learning Areas:

● Learners use Creative Arts knowledge as they draw a map of Eastern Africa, locate the main physical features, and display

in class.

● Learners use English, Kiswahili and Kenyan Sign Language skills as they brainstorm, in pairs, the main physical features.in

Eastern Africa.
